newsitem.title: USA: Burlington to air freight for Wal-Mart
newsitem.headline: Burlington to air freight for Wal-Mart

text.p: Burlington Air Express said it has signed agreement with U.S. retail giant Wal-Mart to provide it with air freight services.

Wal-Mart said it has selected Burlington to be its primary carrier for heavyweight export air shipments of time sensitive shipments over 50 pounds to its 197 international outlets. Burlington also was named secondary carrier for domestic shipments over 50 pounds.
All international expedited orders emanate from Wal-Mart's Bentonville, Arkansas, headquarters. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
